stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Michael Castle holding 41 pts - top of the table like the Dolphins, young comp, old head

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 5 & 11 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 19 on the back nine after 13 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 257 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 3 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Ian Menz - the club is glad to host Gundagai District Services GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 4 marker sitting 7th

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Made the Turn Count
stories.detail: The round pivoted at the turn - found something on 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: The Merchant
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ on the card - all over the card in the best possible way

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 7 & 8 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 4, 5 & 6 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Fast Starter
stories.detail: Nine-plus out of the gate - 9 in the opening three

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 3 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Feast or Famine
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers, 3 blanks - no interest in the middle ground

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 15 & 16 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 3-7

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 9 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Left the Clubs at Home
stories.detail: 3 wipes in a row on holes 14, 15 & 16

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 15, back nine 7 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: The Flat White Round
stories.detail: 8 twos in a row on holes 8-16 - reliable, consistent, zero drama

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Daniel Rafter was 2nd, sits 10th - a Collingwood fade: close enough to hurt
